captions: Figure 12: Unit process raw data of biogas purification processes
Figure 11: Metadata of biogas purification processes
reason: Figure 12 (p.20) is the 'Unit process raw data of biogas purification processes' — the purification step that turns biogas into methane, which is this dataset; the report prints the several purification variants (pressure swing adsorption, amine scrubbing, membrane) side by side in that one table, so the right column has to be picked inside it. Figure 11 on p.19 is its metadata. Figures 4, 8 and 10 are the upstream biogas production from slurry, biowaste and sewage sludge, not the purification.
